what: converter-tier material cards by unit-cell homogenization (TCPMT round 3: one card per MIXED tier of every design of the design record); production uses the cards of the design in force

replaces.mixed tiers: the single-class tier cards (conv_gan_hs, conv_gan_ls, conv_cfly_a0/a1, conv_ind_cout) of the 49-cell build

legacy_gap_variant: conv_gap_legacy (final_closure_sensitivity): the encapsulant cap over parts shorter than their tier (GAP_MODEL 'encapsulant'), the cards before review round 3

post_bases.current: lower bound: posts carry the terminal RMS currents (ledger netlist) at J_POST
post_bases.land: production: die datasheet land pattern (Cu-pillar die: pillar footprint), MLCC electrode bands at the nominal e, inductor current at J_POST
post_bases.terminal: upper bound: die solder-bar / bump outline, MLCC bands at the largest e, inductor current at J_POST / 2

method:
conductivity  through the thickness: parallel prisms that span the tier (exact for
                prisms), each prism a SERIES stack of its own layers (die body + solder
                terminal; capacitor mount + body) and, over a part shorter than its tier,
                the gap layer: copper posts on the part's terminals in the encapsulant
                (review round 3; the legacy encapsulant cap is variant conv_gap_legacy);
                in plane: each component
                in its share of the cell, the classical series-parallel (Kirchhoff/Rayleigh)
                bounds of a rectangular inclusion in a periodic rectangular cell (adiabatic
                planes -> lower, isothermal planes -> upper), averaged over the two in-plane
                directions; the production in-plane value is the midpoint of that bracket.
                Outer bounds: Reuss (series) and Voigt (parallel) over the phase fractions.
  elasticity    Voigt and Reuss over the phase volume fractions; production iso E = Hill
                (their mean), nu = volume mean.
  expansion     iso-strain (Turner, modulus-weighted) and iso-stress (volume mean) bounds;
                production iso CTE = Turner: the stiff phases (Si dies, MLCC ceramic, Cu)
                span the tier and are bonded to continuous RDL above and below, which
                enforces nearly common in-plane strain.
  The FE takes iso E/nu/CTE and orthotropic k (etm.config.Material); the full set with its
  bounds is in the JSON for the mechanical model.
mixed_tier_method:
The card of one MIXED converter tier from what it holds (TCPMT round 3; gap posts:
    review round 3).

    Every part is a vertical COLUMN spanning the tier, a series stack of its own layers (die:
    solder terminal + body; MLCC: mount + part, with its Cu end terminations as a parallel
    prism; inductor: its homogenized envelope) and, over a part shorter than its tier, the
    GAP LAYER: copper posts on the part's terminals bridging it to the RDLs (the authors'
    assumption: terminals on both faces; the split of the gap between the faces does not
    change a series column), sized by POST_BASIS (production 'land': a die's datasheet land
    pattern, an MLCC's electrode bands, an inductor's current at J_POST), the rest of the gap
    encapsulant. The columns and the encapsulant fill act in parallel through the thickness.
    A tier holding inductors also carries their output-current posts (Cu prisms spanning the
    tier, sized at the intra-VR current density for the share of the cell output current
    those inductors deliver). In plane: each component in its area share of the cell
    (series-parallel bracket, midpoint). Mechanics: Voigt/Reuss/Hill and Turner/volume-mean
    over the volume fractions, as the single-class cards. The card records the k_z / k_xy
    range over the post bases ('current' lower, 'terminal' upper) for the uncertainty step
    and the legacy encapsulant-gap value (GAP_MODEL 'encapsulant', variant conv_gap_legacy).
    The via conductors of nets crossing the tier are NOT in the card (declared, conservative
    for k_z).

encapsulant.source: configs/phase0b/package_stack.yaml underfill_homog (the framework's fill, also between the cells)

solder.source: SAC305; k from z2_converter.K_SOLDER, E/CTE from the column-stiffened attach card (z2_converter.vr_attach_material); nu ASSUMPTION

nickel.source: handbook values (CRC Handbook of Chemistry and Physics; ASM)

termination.source: fired Cu thick-film MLCC end termination: k from Wiedemann-Franz at a typical fired thick-film resistivity ~2.7 uOhm cm (bulk Cu 1.7 -> 400 W/mK); E/CTE of the copper card

batio3.source: BaTiO3-based X7R/X7T MLCC dielectric, literature-typical values (MLCC bodies are quoted at ~10-12 ppm/K)

fe_alloy.source: Fe-based soft-magnetic alloy powder (Fe-Si/Fe-Si-Cr/amorphous class; pure Fe 80 W/mK, amorphous ~9 W/mK)

mould.source: filled epoxy mould compound class (k 0.9 W/mK, E 20 GPa, CTE 10 ppm/K below Tg; the mould values of the earlier declared QFN body)

tym5.source: inductor paper Table II (mu_r 15, B_sat 1.25 T, Taiyo Yuden TY-M5); metal fraction from B_sat(composite)/B_sat(alloy) over the Table II alloys with B_sat >= 1.56 T; k DECLARED within the insulated-particle effective-medium bracket (Hashin-Shtrikman lower ~1.5 W/mK at 0.70)

EPC2014C.source: EPC2014C datasheet, DIE OUTLINE: A 1702, B 1087; bars 3-5 200 x 834 um, pads 1-2 200 x 316 um; terminal 100 +/- 20 um; overall 685 um (815 max)
EPC2014C.land_source: EPC2014C datasheet, RECOMMENDED LAND PATTERN (solder mask defined): bars 3-5 180 x 814 um, pads 1-2 180 x 296 um

EPC2057.source: EPC2057 datasheet, DIE OUTLINE: A 1500, B 1200; pad 1 250 x 300, pad 2 250 x 525, pads 3-4 250 x 1050 um; die 518 +/- 25, bump 120 +/- 12 um; overall 638 um

EPC2055.source: EPC2055 datasheet, DIE OUTLINE (solder bump view): A 2500, B 1500; pad 1 (gate) 250 x 300, pad 2 (source) 250 x 825, bars 3, 5 (drain) 250 x 1175, bars 4, 6 (source) 250 x 1350 um; die 518 +/- 25, bump 120 +/- 12, overall 638 um
EPC2055.land_source: EPC2055 datasheet, RECOMMENDED LAND PATTERN (solder mask defined): 230 x 280, 230 x 805, 230 x 1155 (x2), 230 x 1330 (x2) um

EPC2090.source: EPC2090 datasheet, DIE OUTLINE (solder bump view): A 2300, B 1450; 35 bumps c x d = 150 x 180 um, radius 75; 518 die + 50 Cu + 3 Ni + 35 solder = 606 um (solder card for the whole terminal). Cu pillar die for use in a package: no land pattern (the posts take the pillar footprint)

qfn.die_thickness_rule: the silicon path of the card reproduces the published R_thJC (Case TOP = the exposed die): t_Si = R_thJC k_Si A_die; the internal joint takes the rest of A - A3
qfn.leadframe_rule: the leadframe spans A3 = 0.20 mm at the published land pattern inside the outline (the terminals seen from the bottom); mould between
